question: Estimate the market opportunity for Indian online education (formal degree + upskilling) by 2030.
idealClarificationQuestions: Online + hybrid education market by 2030? Yes.
Includes K-12 + JEE/NEET + UG/PG online degrees + upskilling? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: K-12 EdTech (PhysicsWallah, Aakash digital, Allen): ~₹40,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Online UG/PG degrees (UpGrad, Great Learning, Coursera India, Simplilearn): ~₹20,000 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~₹1.1 lakh Cr Indian online ed market by 2030.

calculationFlow: K-12 EdTech (PhysicsWallah, Aakash digital, Allen): ~₹40,000 Cr.
Test prep (JEE, NEET, UPSC, banking): ~₹25,000 Cr.
Online UG/PG degrees (UpGrad, Great Learning, Coursera India, Simplilearn): ~₹20,000 Cr.
Corporate upskilling (Skillsoft, LinkedIn Learning, internal corporate L&D): ~₹15,000 Cr.
Coding bootcamps (Scaler, Masai, Newton School): ~₹8,000 Cr.
Total: ~₹1.1 lakh Cr Indian online ed market by 2030.
